sources: 108 signed V1 interventions, no repeated streams. Score all roots, inherit commercial train/calibration/4 held maps; 2 newer whole-game holdouts and 14 ladder games have no signed counterfactuals and are predictive evaluation only.
intervention: Use only original parent or alternative COMPLETE joint commands already matched to these signed branches. Check edited collectors under both exact own orders. If either target has multiple possible rivals, any unforecast rival, another friendly unit already destined for it, an own recruit onto it, or it is an enemy base, keep parent. Global force-stop or partial-action substitution excluded.
expected: Expected changed own cargo from a known single opponent crossing = probability from its 5-way calibrated physical movement times the cargo actually acquired/forfeited under official unique-lightest collector rule; ties have no survivor, a live own tree/base receives or ground/opponent receives. Zero-collision clear home adds current own principal after movement and smelt cost as a separate explicitly scored delivery, unguarded contested delivery receives no credit. All other endpoints score zero. We require differential contact score >1e-8 in absolute magnitude and incremental summed score above +1e-8 to change. No differential predicted collision -> parent. Report also uniform direction, all same selection/eligibility gates; 3/5-step heads are diagnostic only.
accounting: Call cash ledger on each signed real arm, take exact selected scores and realized captures/deposits. Each terrain equal weight, all roots incl parent-preserved. Require both held-map mean improvement in own actual normal deposits and in official margin, >=1 changed root; exact threshold zero. Signed diagnostic is not a deployment certificate.
